Facts: High (被告人高某甲) attacked Wang (王某乙) with an axe, hitting his head, then smashed his car (multiple parts) causing damage valued 6340 yuan. He later turned himself in (self-surrender). The prosecution says his behavior violates criminal law, and self-surrender applies.
